title: Scope the API-doc generators to a single project/crate, wire per-project Nx targets, and document a task-completion regen rule
objective: Owner-directed new coordination rule: whenever an agent finishes a task, it must regenerate the API-reference evidence for whatever project/crate it touched -- but scoped to just that one, not the whole repo, so this stays cheap as the repo grows. Requires: (1) generate-api-docs.mjs and generate-rust-api-docs.mjs accept an optional single target name and only process that one instead of always processing every discovered target; (2) a docs-generate/docs-check Nx target on each of the 10 documented projects' own project.json (4 TS: ui, x6-canvas, isekai-web-client, architecture-studio; 6 Rust: graph-core, engine-compute-api, engine-compute-cpu, engine-domain-core, isekai-capi-bridge, isekai-wasm-bridge) so an agent runs e.g. `nx run ui:docs-generate` for exactly the project it edited; (3) the rule itself written into .ai/coordination/PROTOCOL.md's task-completion section. The existing whole-repo docs:api:ts:check/docs:api:rust:check (already wired into docs:check/CI) stays as-is as the backstop that catches anyone who skipped the per-project step -- this task adds the cheap per-project path, it does not replace the full check.
validations: generate-api-docs.mjs/generate-rust-api-docs.mjs now accept an optional positional target name; tested directly: `node ... ui --check` and `node ... grafting-graph-core --check` each processed only that one target, an unknown name errored clearly, and the no-argument form still processed all discovered targets (4 TS, 6 Rust) exactly as before.

All 10 new per-project Nx docs-generate/docs-check targets tested directly, not just via the aggregate: `nx run ui:docs-check`, `nx run graph-core:docs-check`, `nx run isekai-wasm-bridge:docs-check`, `nx run architecture-studio:docs-check` all ran in 2-4s each (vs. the full docs:check chain's much longer run), confirming the actual scoping win the owner asked for.

Found and fixed two real, pre-existing latent bugs surfaced only by regenerating docs/generated/project-graph.json for the first time since the root 'grafting' Nx project was created (G-TOOLING-NX-ROOT-TARGETS, earlier this session): (1) Nx's default package.json-script target inference was creating extra colon-named target nodes (e.g. 'graph:generate') alongside the explicit hyphen-named ones already declared in root project.json, violating the Graph IR ID pattern -- fixed via `"nx": {"includedScripts": []}` in root package.json, a real documented Nx option (verified in the installed nx@23.1.0 source before using it), not a workaround; (2) graph-ir-extract.mjs's manifestRelativeFor built './project.json' for the root project (whose Nx root is '.'), and validate-graph-ir.mjs's own normalized-path check rejects a '.' path segment -- fixed the join logic itself (joinRepoRelative), not the validator.
node --test tools/scripts/graph-ir-extract.test.mjs: 7/7 passing after the joinRepoRelative fix.
node tools/scripts/graph-ir-extract.mjs / --check: converges (88 nodes, 86 edges, up from 49/48 now that the root 'grafting' project and its targets are correctly included).
pnpm run docs:check: full 7-step chain passes end to end after both root-cause fixes.
git status --short: only this task's declared affected_paths changed, confirmed alongside other pre-existing uncommitted work from earlier in this session.

.ai/coordination/PROTOCOL.md: new rule 6 under 'Completing or blocking work' documents the scoped-regeneration requirement; tools/scripts/README.md cross-references it from the API-reference extractors section.
artifacts: tools/scripts/graph-ir-extract.mjs (joinRepoRelative fix for the root project's '.' path)
package.json (nx.includedScripts: [] to stop duplicate colon-named target inference)

10 project.json files (docs-generate/docs-check Nx targets: ui, x6-canvas, isekai-web-client, architecture-studio, graph-core, engine-compute-api, engine-compute-cpu, engine-domain-core, isekai-capi-bridge, isekai-wasm-bridge)
docs/generated/project-graph.json, repo-map.md, grafting.graph.json (regenerated to reflect the new targets and both bug fixes)
tools/scripts/README.md (per-project regeneration rule cross-referenced in the API-reference extractors section)
risks: Deliberately not adding hard guard enforcement (agent-task-guard.mjs blocking task completion if the corresponding docs file wasn't regenerated) in this pass -- that needs new source-path-to-project-name mapping logic duplicated into the guard plus new tests, a meaningfully bigger and separate change the owner did not explicitly ask for. This task ships the documented rule plus the cheap tooling to follow it; hard enforcement is a clearly flagged possible follow-up, not silently deferred.

Per-project Nx target names (docs-generate/docs-check) are new on all 10 project.json files; chosen to not collide with any existing target name already present on those same files (checked: none currently have docs-generate or docs-check).
